TinyFish raises $47 million in ICONIQ-led round.

The Challenge We Tackled Together

TinyFish had an impressive product already built—AI agents that intelligently automate web tasks for major companies—but they had no brand to match the tech. TinyFish operate in the cutting-edge world of the agentic web, where AI learns and executes complex tasks, like competitive price tracking and product research, but their visual identity didn't tell that story. The challenge? Creating a brand from scratch that could make advanced AI feel approachable and memorable, while capturing the intelligent, methodical nature of what their technology actually does.

How We Made It Happen

We developed a complete visual system with unexpected tones and colors, designed multiple facial expressions to show personality, and created a motion brand that brought the character to life. The centerpiece was creating their character—a thoughtful, methodical tiny fish that became the face of their technology. We explored different applications from signage to apparel, developed comprehensive brand guidelines, and introduced the concept of "the shoal"—because tiny fish are stronger together, just like their AI agents working in concert.

What We Achieved Together

We gave TinyFish a brand identity that makes complex AI technology feel human and approachable. The tiny fish character is instantly recognizable, and the complete visual system—from colors to motion to messaging—gave them everything needed to stand out in a crowded AI space. The timing couldn't have been better: after the brand launch, TinyFish raised $47 million in their seed round. The new brand is smart and distinctive as the tech they're building, turning what could be an illusive tech concept into something people actually want to engage with.

Through thick and thin, they are Upshop's go-to for brand + digital.

The Challenge We Tackled Together 

We’ve been Upshop’s creative partners since the very beginning—building their first brand, watching them grow, and celebrating every milestone along the way. But here’s the thing about success: it changes what you need. As Upshop evolved into the dynamic force they are today, their original identity started feeling too small for their big ambitions. They came to us with exciting momentum and a clear vision: they needed their brand to evolve alongside their growth. The challenge? Taking the solid foundation we’d created together years ago and transforming it into something sharper, bolder, and more dynamic—without losing the authentic spirit that got them here.

At the heart of that evolution is Upshop 360, a powerful platform that unifies supply, demand, production, markdowns, and fulfillment into one intelligent system. It optimizes every aspect of store operations—from distribution center to doorstep—giving retailers the clarity, control, and agility they need to deliver smarter, faster, and more efficiently than ever before.

How We Made It Happen 

We weren’t starting from scratch; we were building on a relationship and a brand we knew inside and out. Our approach touched everything: strategy sessions that redefined how Upshop speaks to the world, branding that captures their vibrant confidence, and development work that makes every interaction feel effortless. As their business evolved, they needed a new site that could do more than just tell their story—it had to redefine their expanding offerings and spotlight their powerful 360 solutions. We reimagined typography, crafted motion that brings their story to life, and created a digital experience that moves as fast as their business does. Every choice was made to amplify what makes Upshop special while setting them up for the exciting chapters ahead.

What We Achieved Together 

The new brand clarifies their messaging, simplifies how people navigate their world, and builds stronger connections between Upshop and their audience. The website now tells a richer visual story—one that bridges the power of the Upshop 360 platform with the customers who use it every day. Through purposeful design, motion, and storytelling, it shows how each part of the 360 ecosystem works together to simplify operations, empower teams, and elevate the customer experience. The result? A brand that’s not just beautiful, but a powerful tool that drives engagement and strengthens Upshop’s mission.

The Challenge We Tackled Together

Barrow Street Nursery School is a private school in New York with a distinctive building and a warm educational philosophy. They needed a digital presence that could capture the joy and curiosity of early childhood learning. The challenge was creating a brand and website that felt playful and inviting without becoming chaotic. A site sophisticated enough for discerning parents, yet approachable enough to reflect the students themselves. It also needed to be a robust platform capable of supporting everything from admissions to calendar management.

How We Made It Happen

We reimagined Barrow Street's brand and website with a visual system centered around their iconic building—a perfect symbol of the community they've built. To keep the identity warm and authentic, we developed an illustration style inspired by the imagination and creativity of a child's hand. Bright, energetic photography captures real moments of learning and discovery, while simple, intuitive navigation helps parents quickly find the information they need. We integrated video throughout the site, built a comprehensive calendar system, and introduced subtle animations that bring the experience to life without overwhelming it. Every detail was designed to balance sophistication with the genuine joy of early childhood education.

What We Achieved Together 

The playful illustration style and child-inspired details give the site an authentic sense of warmth, while the clean layout and thoughtful structure inspire confidence in parents exploring the school. Years later, the website is still going strong—a testament to thoughtful strategy, timeless design, and a flexible digital foundation. Barrow Street now has a brand and website that reflect what makes its approach to education so special: joyful, nurturing, and built on the belief that learning should always feel full of possibility.
Graphic highlighting ProSupps’ commitment to quality with “Substance Tested / Licensed Ingredients” text.

The Challenge We Tackled Together

ProSupps already had an established brand in the competitive supplement space, but they wanted to break away from the pack. They had bold red, black, and white branding and premium products, but their digital presence wasn't matching the energy of what they were selling. The challenge? Creating an immersive, effects-driven website that could showcase their products in a way no other supplement brand was doing—something that felt as powerful and dynamic as the supplements themselves while keeping all the nutritional information searchable and accessible.

How We Made It Happen

We built an immersive web experience loaded with 3D visuals and embedded video content featuring their brand ambassadors. The product pages didn’t just display supplements—they brought them to life with motion, depth, and a storytelling-driven approach. Instead of relying on static images for nutritional information, we built everything in searchable HTML through the CMS, making it both visually impressive and functionally smart. Beyond the visuals, we restructured the entire sales flow and user interface to create a more captivating and intuitive shopping experience. By simplifying navigation, introducing guided product discovery, and refining calls to action, we made it easier for users to explore, compare, and purchase products seamlessly. Each step in the buying journey was designed to feel more fluid and engaging, turning what could have been a simple transaction into a brand-driven experience.

What We Achieved Together

We created a digital experience that ProSupps loved—one that matched the intensity of their brand and products. The immersive effects, 3D elements, and video integration set them apart in a crowded market, while the smart approach to product information made everything accessible without sacrificing style. We restructured how information was displayed, creating a clearer hierarchy that guided users seamlessly from curiosity to conversion. Every interaction reinforced their bold tagline—“No Excuses, Just Results”—through purposeful design choices, motivational storytelling, and a performance-driven flow that inspired users to take action. The result was a stronger, more engaging product funnel that encouraged exploration, deepened engagement, and drove confident purchases.

The Challenge We Tackled Together 

When we first met Suzy Welch, she had thousands of followers, a reputation in the career coaching and self-help space. Suzy is a professor, author, and genuinely brilliant thinker—but she didn't have a brand to amplify her voice or a digital platform to house the ambitious vision she was building toward. The challenge? Creating a brand foundation that could grow with her, then evolving it into a full ecosystem of complex assessment tools—each with its own identity—that could help people discover their values, navigate their careers, and connect with others in meaningful ways.

How We Made It Happen 

We started by building Suzy's core brand—messaging, colors, site architecture, and a website that set the stage for everything to come. Once her book launched, the real work began. One by one, we created separate assessment platforms: Pi360, Values Bridge, Compass Careers, Four Horsemen, and her breakout hit, Values Bridge. Each tool has its own distinct identity but lives within the Suzy Welch universe. These aren't simple quizzes—they're technically complex platforms with intricate equations, personalized results, and the ability to compare values with others to see if you're aligned. We handled all the branding, design, and development, building an empire from the ground up that continues to thrive with ongoing support across multiple products.

What We Achieved Together 

From 12,000 followers to a multi-platform powerhouse, Suzy now has a suite of assessment tools that are genuinely changing how people approach their careers and relationships. Values Bridge alone hit 70,000 signups shortly after launch and continues to gain serious press and momentum. Each platform works seamlessly within her ecosystem, and together they've established Suzy as a leader in self-discovery and career development.

The Challenge We Tackled Together 

New Engen arrived with something special already in hand—a fresh brand identity and a bold vision. But they needed more than just a pretty face. They were in the middle of merging with Donut Studios, bringing together two powerful forces in the creator economy. The challenge? Taking their new brand foundation and building a digital experience that could showcase their work with real impact, unite two companies into one cohesive story, and create a content hub that could keep pace with their constantly evolving blogging culture.

How We Made It Happen 

We built an entire visual ecosystem from their brand foundation. Custom illustration styles, story-driven animations in Rive, and transitions engineered to feel impactful—because that's what "Genuine Impact" demands. We developed a sophisticated blog system with multiple post styles that could flex with their content needs, distinguished their brand and creator audiences, and delivered a complete toolkit of assets that became their full visual language.

What We Achieved Together 

Here's what makes us proud: we didn't just design a website—we completed their brand story. New Engen  walked into this partnership with a foundation, and we built the house. The site showcases their work with the genuine impact they promised, seamlessly merging New Engen and Donut Studios into one unified digital home. Their blog has become a powerhouse, driving serious traffic with real, impressive stats that keep climbing. But the best part? We handed them more than just a beautiful site. We gave them an entire toolkit of brand assets, illustration styles, and design patterns they're actively using to fuel their growth. They took what we built and ran with it—and that's exactly how it should be.
